text:
amir: quick 10-min feedback on the roles table hover affordance + invite preview wording. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/LMN/roles-hover-invite (frame: HoverPreview)
jess: tl;dr: hover card shows too much action clutter. users wanted a single clear CTA (edit role) plus a subtle preview of permissions.
pat: agree. propose trimming actions to Edit + Copy ID, move other actions into kebab menu. hover preview should be compact (1-2 lines) with a link to full details.
amir: accessibility note: hover-only previews are invisible to keyboard/screen reader users. we need a persistent reveal mechanism (focus or expand button).
sam-a11y: recommended pattern:
- make hover card also focusable (use button with aria-expanded)
- ensure preview content has `aria-live=\"polite\"` when toggled via keyboard
- provide `aria-describedby` on role name that points to the preview summary for assistive tech
jess: copy tweak for invite preview: current: "User will have role: Admin (can manage billing)" -> suggested: "Invite preview: role Admin — manages billing, users, and settings." shorter, action-oriented.
pat: and add tiny helper under invite email input: "Recipients will receive role assignment when they accept." avoids confusion about immediate provisioning.
ui-bot: deploy-preview: roles-hover-trim branch deployed at 2025-11-05T14:22:10Z :rocket:
amir: dev follow-ups: pat to convert hover card into focusable button and wire aria attributes; jess to update figma copy; sam to run quick NVDA/VoiceOver checks on staging. leaving thread open for staging results. :thumbsup:
